parole.significato: zipun (medieval Russian type of peasant upper garment)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Venetan zipón, possibly via Greek ζιπούνι (zipoúni), since the 16th century. Ultimately from Arabic جُبَّة (jubba, “long garment”). Doublet of жупа́н (župán), шу́ба (šúba), and ю́бка (júbka). Also doublet of дже́мпер (džémper).
